niche: restating a city's police-recorded aggravated assault series onto the incident-based (NIBRS) basis from the three dual-coded months of the records system cutover
answer: On the NIBRS basis Ellsmere's aggravated assaults rose 1 per cent from 2024 to 2025: 5,254 victims in 2025 against about 5,200 in 2024 restated.
answer_source: submission.md block 1; generator/figures.json call.change_pct, restated_2024, nibrs_2025
analyst_test: With the data cleaned and every rule read correctly, the analyst builds the conversion per Return A line from the October to December 2024 dual-coded months, applies it month by month to January to September 2024 and files a fall of 3 per cent from 2024 to 2025 on the NIBRS basis (2024 restated at about 5,400), where converting the other-assaults line separately for domestic and other victims, each month at its own domestic count from the Domestic Violence Unit's case log, gives about 5,200 and a rise of 1 per cent.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is an official series restated across a classification change through conversion rates estimated on a dual-coded overlap and applied where they are stable, each period weighted by its own composition, which is how statistical producers back-cast a series over a coding break; replacing the conversion with a before-and-after comparison or a single link factor changes the call.

two offense classifications (Return A lines under the hierarchy rule, NIBRS offense codes) on one dual-coded quarter, the summary class filled only there and marked NS and P2 where Return A scored nothing

driver: A count is restated onto a new classification by conversion rates measured on a short window in which every record carries both classifications; within one source class the rate differs sharply between two kinds of record that no column of the source counts separates, and that kind's share of the class is higher in the measured window than in the months being restated, so applying the window's rate per source class carries the window's mix into those months, while the kind is rebuilt from a separate operational log and each month is restated at its own mix.
driver_concrete: Ellsmere's January to September 2024 aggravated assaults are restated onto the NIBRS basis from the October to December 2024 dual-coded months; Return A's other assaults convert to NIBRS aggravated assault at about a fifth when domestic and about three in a thousand otherwise, domestic victims are a larger share of other assaults in the autumn and holiday weeks (35.8 per cent) than in January to September (29.1 per cent), and only the Domestic Violence Unit's case log gives each month's domestic count, so the per-line conversion overstates the restated 2024 base and turns a real rise into a fall.
stump: Restating January to September 2024 at the dual-coded months' conversion rate per Return A line carries October to December's domestic share of other assaults into the rest of the year, overstates the restated 2024 count (about 5,400 against about 5,200), and files a fall of 3 per cent in aggravated assaults from 2024 to 2025 on the NIBRS basis where the series rose 1 per cent.

differentiation.task117: task117 forecasts a summed peak through per-unit caps reached by a dated join; task481 restates a closed year of an official count across a classification change, and its stump is a conversion rate whose within-class mix moves between the dual-coded quarter and the months restated.
differentiation.task137: task137 forecasts a behavioural share at a repricing as a mixture of acquired and long-standing units read off a treatment history; task481 is a backward restatement of a recorded count onto a new coding basis, with no behaviour and no forecast, and the mixture weights are each month's domestic share of simple assaults taken from a separate unit's case log.
differentiation.task37: task37 conditions a forward count on a linked entity's authorisation recovered from a closed roll; task481 has no linked entity and no recovered rule, only conversion rates measured on a dual-coded quarter and applied to earlier months at their own composition.
differentiation.task44: task44 splits a pilot's pooled treatment effect by a behavioural moderator measured over a prior instance of the future window; task481 has no treatment or pilot: the rates are classification conversions from a records-system cutover, the window mismatch is the dual-coded winter quarter against the spring and summer months being restated, and the call is a year-on-year change on the new basis.
differentiation.task97: task97 forecasts repeat need from the cumulative history of a place reached through an account conversion; task481 restates a closed year of crime counts across a coding break by conversion rates per kind of assault.
